[34] AR: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ EN: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
[8] AR: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ EN: Then do not obey the deniers.

folded.id: then|will|we treat the muslims like the criminals?
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

spans.text: [35] AR: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ EN: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

folded.id: there|will|surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person
folded.subject: There
folded.object: surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person

spans.text: [24] AR: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ EN: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
[26] AR: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ EN: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
[16] AR: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ EN: We will brand him upon the snout.

folded.id: we|will|progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know
folded.subject: We
folded.object: progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know

spans.text: We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
[36] AR: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ EN: What is [the matter] with you?
[2] AR: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ EN: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
[4] AR: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ EN: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

folded.id: your lord|is|most knowing of who has gone astray from his way
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: most knowing of who has gone astray from His way

spans.text: [7] AR: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ EN: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
